title: withJobHistory
responsibility: Open the selected job store for a CLI action and close its database on success or failure.

inputs.name: withJobHistory.options
inputs.description: Parsed CLI flags selecting history home, driver input, explicit queue, capacity or what-if. An omitted home uses HARNESS_JOBS_HOME or the stable per-user directory.

inputs.name: withJobHistory.action
inputs.description: Synchronous callback using the open job history; repository closure runs in finally even when this callback throws.

outputs.name: withJobHistory
outputs.description: No return value; registers deferred Commander actions or prints the supplied report without changing queue inputs.
